name: Hadolint Action
description: Action that runs Hadolint Dockerfile linting tool

dockerfile.description: The path to the Dockerfile to lint

recursive.description: Search for specified dockerfile recursively, from the project root

output-file.description: The path where to save the linting results to

no-fail.description: Never exit with a failure status code

verbose.description: Print more information about the running config

format.description:
The output format, one of [tty (default) | json | checkstyle |
codeclimate | gitlab_codeclimate | codacy | sarif]

failure-threshold.description:
Fail the pipeline only if rules with severity above this threshold are
violated. One of [error | warning | info (default) | style | ignore]

override-error.description: A comma separated list of rules whose severity will be `error`

override-warning.description: A comma separated list of rules whose severity will be `warning`

override-info.description: A comma separated list of rules whose severity will be `info`

override-style.description: A comma separated list of rules whose severity will be `style`

ignore.description: A comma separated string of rules to ignore

trusted-registries.description: A comma separated list of trusted registry urls
